database: An rc2 database already starts from the baseline migration, so it is upgraded in place, not recreated. Stop Compose api/dispatcher and back up .lace/data and the object store, then run pnpm db:migrate (Cloudflare: pnpm cf:db:migrate or pnpm exec lace db migrate --target cloudflare-remote --operator-env .lace/cloudflare-operator.env); it applies only the checked-in forward migrations after the baseline. A database created before rc2 predates the baseline and is not supported: lace db migrate and lace doctor report SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED for it and change nothing.
configuration: Template 0.49.0: upgrade all Lace packages and both images together; rc3 installations need no additional schema or user-owned source changes. For rc2 installations, guides and upgrade instructions start at rc2 (template 0.47.0), the oldest supported release, and the operations guide describes the rc2 upgrade without database recreation. Upgrade all Lace packages and both images together, apply the database step, then run pnpm content:sync and rebuild the site. Gallery advances to block version 6: items gain a grid placement (auto, full, start, end) and image items a size (fill or natural), new video items start ambient, and the featured-first preset is removed. Raise the version of every model that allows gallery (the starter's home and posts), then run pnpm content:sync, which migrates stored galleries: featured-first becomes columns-2 with a full first item, and video items without a playback keep player. Before the next build run pnpm exec lace add block gallery --site site (or review the .new proposal of an edited component) and adopt the natural-size theme rules from docs/lace-astro-site.md; until then the theme crops natural images. A custom block that stored featured-first must migrate it the same way in its own block migration.
